$ curl -s -X POST /tenant/agent-tasks/42/cancel
HTTP OK
{
  "cancelled": true,
  "id": 42,
  "in_process": false
}

$ curl -s -X POST /tenant/agent-tasks/41/cancel
HTTP OK
{
  "cancelled": true,
  "id": 41,
  "in_process": true
}

$ curl -s -X GET /tenant/agent-tasks/not-a-number/events?limit=8
HTTP Bad Request
{
  "error": "agent task id is required"
}
